opening.argument: Judge, consider the combined effect of the upside signals. The narration describes bulls calling for $500, then cites models projecting $900 by 2026. It frames that larger number as more than wishful thinking and invokes Visa’s use of Solana as a “massive vote of confidence.” Those are powerful credibility and appreciation cues for a speculative token. The warnings are real, but they do not remove the risk that viewers take the striking targets and institutional validation as the video’s actionable message.

opening.argument: Judge, the news format can itself steer interest toward SOL. The title asks whether SOL can reclaim $100; the narration gives the recovery case substantial space, calling the technology fast and cheap and describing Visa’s decision as a real-world endorsement. It then identifies strong underlying infrastructure even while acknowledging weak activity. Read as a whole, that framing offers a reason to look past current losses and consider future appreciation. The bear case makes the presentation look balanced, but it also sets up a comeback narrative.
